$Comment: Percent faster block breaking on every block, in whole percent points (10 is +10%). ziggfreed-common's gather step (world/gather/GatherSpeedSystem) sums it with each GatherSpeed_<Family> stat whose block family holds the block, GatherSpeed_Placed on a placed block, the GatherRhythm chain and any stat a mod names for the block, holds the sum at the cap this file's ZigCeiling tag names (200, triple speed at most; nothing raises it, and a server changes it by shipping this file with another value) and multiplies each hit's block damage by it. The tool still decides what it can break, so speed never mines a tier early. A talent that counts only underground, in water or under open sky grants it bound While that condition. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
